topic.title: Planning and Learning under Partial Observability
topic.overview: When an agent cannot directly observe the state, its decisions must depend on beliefs or informative histories rather than the latest observation alone. These papers study POMDP representations, planning algorithms, policy optimization, and the geometry of achievable value functions. Approximation is central because exact belief-space reasoning can be computationally and statistically difficult.
topic.whyItMatters: Treating an observation as a complete state can produce systematically poor actions. Useful approximations need to preserve enough history for decision-making while making learning and planning feasible.
topic.evolution: Early representatives address incremental planning and learning without explicit state estimation. Later work introduces Bayesian adaptation and online planning guarantees. The 2024–2026 evidence develops provable representations, finite-history reductions with quantified approximation error, and geometric descriptions that expose optimization difficulties unique to partial observability.
openQuestions: How much history is necessary when the environment changes?
Can practical belief approximations provide reliable error estimates for the resulting policy?

papers.tldr: Logical state abstractions extend a practical AIXI approximation to structured environments whose behavior depends on history.

papers.title: Bayesian Risk Markov Decision Processes

papers.title: Confident Approximate Policy Iteration for Efficient Local Planning in $q^\pi$-realizable MDPs
papers.tldr: CAPI improves planning accuracy while retaining stationary policies and combines strong simulator-query bounds with increased memory and computation.

papers.title: Learning in Observable POMDPs, without Computationally Intractable Oracles
papers.tldr: The paper gives a quasipolynomial-time, oracle-free learning algorithm for POMDPs satisfying a specified observability assumption.

papers.title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Episodic Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes under Non-Parametric Models
papers.tldr: Proxy-based bridge functions enable nonparametric policy evaluation in partially observed systems with finite-sample error guarantees.

papers.title: Planning to the Information Horizon of BAMDPs via Epistemic State Abstraction
papers.tldr: The paper measures Bayesian planning difficulty through information acquisition and develops an epistemic state abstraction for tractable approximate planning.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with a Terminator
papers.tldr: Modeling external, history-dependent interruptions leads to a theoretically supported reinforcement-learning algorithm and a scalable method with strong reported results.

papers.title: Robust $\phi$-Divergence MDPs

papers.title: Semi-infinitely Constrained Markov Decision Processes

papers.title: Computationally Efficient PAC RL in POMDPs with Latent Determinism and Conditional Embeddings

papers.title: Learning in POMDPs is Sample-Efficient with Hindsight Observability
papers.tldr: Revealing hidden states retrospectively during training enables provably sample-efficient learning in some otherwise statistically intractable partially observable problems.

papers.title: On the Occupancy Measure of Non-Markovian Policies in Continuous MDPs
papers.tldr: The paper extends occupancy equivalence between history-dependent and memoryless policies to continuous MDPs while identifying failures when occupancy is infinite.

papers.title: Optimistic Planning by Regularized Dynamic Programming
papers.tldr: Regularized value updates enable efficient optimistic planning with near-optimal statistical guarantees in discounted linear mixture MDPs.

papers.title: Provably Efficient Representation Learning with Tractable Planning in Low-Rank POMDP
papers.tldr: The paper develops sample-efficient representation learning and tractable planning for structured POMDP classes using supervised-learning oracles.

papers.title: Robust Satisficing MDPs
papers.tldr: Robust satisficing MDPs use soft performance targets under model ambiguity, offering a tractable alternative to conservative worst-case planning.

papers.title: Set-membership Belief State-based Reinforcement Learning for POMDPs
papers.tldr: SBRL controls partially observed systems using learned belief sets that provably contain the true state under unknown-but-bounded noise.

papers.title: A Reduction-based Framework for Sequential Decision Making with Delayed Feedback
papers.tldr: A reduction converts compatible multi-batched decision-making algorithms into sample-efficient methods for stochastic delayed feedback.

papers.title: Active Observing in Continuous-time Control
papers.tldr: The paper shows that irregular observation timing can improve continuous-time control with observation costs and tests an initial heuristic planner.

papers.title: Beyond Average Return in Markov Decision Processes
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes limits on exact return-based planning and bounds approximate evaluation of richer objectives in finite-horizon, undiscounted Markov Decision Processes.

papers.title: Finding Counterfactually Optimal Action Sequences in Continuous State Spaces
papers.tldr: An A*-based method finds counterfactually optimal discrete action sequences in continuous-state models under a Lipschitz continuity condition.

papers.title: Finding Safe Zones of Markov Decision Processes Policies
papers.tldr: The paper approximates compact state sets that contain most trajectories of a given policy, with guarantees on both size and escape probability.

papers.title: Future-Dependent Value-Based Off-Policy Evaluation in POMDPs
papers.tldr: Future-dependent value functions enable off-policy evaluation with guarantees when observed histories and futures sufficiently reveal hidden-state information.

papers.title: Information-guided Planning: An Online Approach for Partially Observable Problems
papers.tldr: IB-POMCP guides planning with belief uncertainty, improving reported rewards and reasoning time in partially observable benchmark scenarios.

papers.title: Online POMDP Planning with Anytime Deterministic Guarantees
papers.tldr: The paper derives deterministic bounds for simplified POMDP planning and shows how to attach them to existing sampling-based solvers.

papers.title: Persuading Farsighted Receivers in MDPs: the Power of Honesty
papers.tldr: Compact, honest promises enable efficient computation of optimal epsilon-persuasive history-dependent signaling for farsighted receivers.

papers.title: POMDP Planning for Object Search in Partially Unknown Environment
papers.tldr: GPOMCP combines a growing search model, conditional reuse of planning work, and exploratory guidance to improve simulated robot object search.

papers.title: Reference-Based POMDPs

papers.title: Efficient Value Iteration for s-rectangular Robust Markov Decision Processes
papers.tldr: Explicit robust Bellman updates make planning with coupled action uncertainties faster and reveal threshold structure in optimal policies.

papers.title: How to Explore with Belief: State Entropy Maximization in POMDPs
papers.tldr: A belief-based policy-gradient method approximates true-state entropy maximization when agents can observe the environment only partially.

papers.title: Prospective Side Information for Latent MDPs
papers.tldr: Weak clues about hidden episode context enable an exponential sample-complexity improvement, with matching K^(2/3) regret bounds for sample-efficient learning.

papers.title: Provable Representation with Efficient Planning for Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: A representation-based framework makes partially observable reinforcement learning tractable, with statistical analysis and strong benchmark performance.

papers.title: SaVeR: Optimal Data Collection Strategy for Safe Policy Evaluation in Tabular MDP
papers.tldr: SaVeR collects data for accurate policy evaluation under a default-policy-based safety constraint, alongside tractability analysis and error guarantees.

papers.title: Belief-State Query Policies for User-Aligned POMDPs
papers.tldr: Belief-state query policies make user-constrained planning under partial observability optimizable, with alignment guarantees and convergence to optimal behavior in the limit.

papers.title: Computational Aspects of Bayesian Persuasion under Approximate Best Response
papers.tldr: The paper gives exact and approximate persuasion algorithms for near-optimal receiver responses, alongside a general computational hardness result.

papers.title: Mitigating Partial Observability in Sequential Decision Processes via the Lambda Discrepancy
papers.tldr: Disagreement between two temporal-difference value estimates can detect partial observability and guide an agent toward more useful memory.

papers.title: On the Curses of Future and History in Future-dependent Value Functions for Off-policy Evaluation
papers.tldr: The paper exposes hidden exponential terms in future-dependent off-policy evaluation and gives coverage assumptions that permit polynomial bounds.

papers.title: On the Role of Information Structure in Reinforcement Learning for Partially-Observable Sequential Teams and Games
papers.tldr: An explicit graph model of information structure yields sample-complexity bounds and a way to identify tractable sequential decision problems.

papers.title: RL in Latent MDPs is Tractable: Online Guarantees via Off-Policy Evaluation
papers.tldr: New off-policy evaluation and coverage tools yield near-optimal exploration guarantees for latent MDPs without additional structural assumptions.

papers.title: What type of inference is planning?

papers.title: Model-Based Exploration in Monitored Markov Decision Processes
papers.tldr: A model-based exploration algorithm learns minimax-optimal policies with finite-sample guarantees even when some rewards are never observable.

papers.title: Rank-One Modified Value Iteration
papers.tldr: A rank-one transition approximation improves reported planning and learning performance while retaining convergence rates and complexity matching value iteration and Q-learning.

papers.title: Agents Robust to Distribution Shifts Learn Causal World Models Even Under Mediation
papers.tldr: The paper links robust adaptation to causal knowledge and shows how to extract that knowledge even when agents change their environments.

papers.title: Breaking the Order Barrier: Off-Policy Evaluation for Confounded POMDPs
papers.tldr: The paper derives conditional finite-sample guarantees showing how horizon, hidden confounding, and policy memory affect off-policy evaluation error.

papers.title: Multi-agent Markov Entanglement

papers.title: Multi-Environment POMDPs: Discrete Model Uncertainty Under Partial Observability
papers.tldr: The paper develops reformulations and algorithms for policies that maximize worst-case reward across multiple partially observable environment models.

papers.title: Non-rectangular Robust MDPs with Normed Uncertainty Sets

papers.title: NS-Gym: A Comprehensive and Open-Source Simulation Framework for Non-Stationary Markov Decision Processes
papers.tldr: NS-Gym supplies modular Gymnasium-based simulations and benchmarks for evaluating decision-making algorithms in environments that change over time.

papers.title: On Evaluating Policies for Robust POMDPs
papers.tldr: The paper improves robust POMDP evaluation with demanding benchmarks, an equivalent-MDP method, and useful policy-quality bounds.

papers.title: Projection-based Lyapunov method for fully heterogeneous weakly-coupled MDPs

papers.title: Scalable Policy-Based RL Algorithms for POMDPs

papers.title: Sequential Monte Carlo for Policy Optimization in Continuous POMDPs

papers.title: Skill-Driven Neurosymbolic State Abstractions

papers.title: SPOT: Scalable Policy Optimization with Trees for Markov Decision Processes

papers.title: Stochastic Principal-Agent Problems: Computing and Learning Optimal History-Dependent Policies
papers.tldr: Inducible value sets enable efficient approximate history-dependent policies and sublinear-regret learning in a stochastic principal-agent model.

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Round Allocation with Stochastic Arrivals
papers.tldr: A compact population-level planning model makes adaptive recruitment allocation tractable and provides bounds on errors from misspecified models.

papers.title: Dynamic Programming for Epistemic Uncertainty in Markov Decision Processes
papers.tldr: The paper unifies risk-sensitive treatment of uncertain transition probabilities and characterizes which law-invariant risk measures permit dynamic programming.

papers.title: Fast Mixing Steady-State Control in Markov Decision Processes
papers.tldr: The paper develops a tractable surrogate and offline learning algorithm for policies that rapidly approach a prescribed steady-state distribution.

papers.title: Local Policies for Graph-Structured Markov Decision Processes

papers.title: Noise as a Natural Regularizer in Markov Decision Processes: Connecting Environmental Stochasticity and Policy Simplicity

papers.title: The Cost of Commitment in Option-Based Hierarchical RL
papers.tldr: Commitment loss formalizes how option termination should balance deliberation costs against model errors that accumulate during execution.

papers.title: The Value Function Semi-Algebraic Set in Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes
papers.tldr: Feasible POMDP value functions under memoryless stochastic policies obey polynomial constraints that reveal nonlinear optimization geometry.
